turnaround_reason: Nutritional-snacking company whose flagship Atkins brand is in steep decline (partly GLP-1/low-carb fade), dragging the stock from ~$29 to near its 52-week low ~$9.9; it is basing on the hope Quest and OWYN offset Atkins.
bullish_points: Quest, the crown-jewel brand, is still growing (+1.1% Q3, +3.4% nine-month) and is the real long-term asset.
Cheap: fwd P/E ~6.8, EV ~$1.3B on ~$1.4B revenue after the drawdown.
Trading near 52-week low with sentiment washed out; +5-6% over the last 5-30 days suggests basing.
Impairment is non-cash; underlying cash generation remains intact.
bearish_points: Atkins is collapsing: -24.6% in Q3, -22.6% nine-month — likely a structural decline, not a blip, as GLP-1s and shifting diets erode low-carb demand.
FY26 guidance cut to $1.31-1.35B net sales (-10% to -7% YoY); a $249M Atkins/OWYN impairment drove a $159.7M net loss.
OWYN still working through a product-quality issue and retailer destocking.
Turnaround hinges on Quest outgrowing Atkins' shrink — not yet demonstrated at the consolidated level.
catalyst: Quest growth reaccelerating enough to offset Atkins decay; stabilization of consolidated net sales / guidance.
suggested_trade: Pass / tiny value nibble near lows only; wait for consolidated sales to stop declining.
key_risk: Atkins keeps falling faster than Quest grows, so total company revenue keeps shrinking.
would_skip_if: Consolidated net sales keep declining — i.e., under current guidance.
